explanation: In Egypt, exchanging business cards is a warm gesture that lends credibility and legitimacy to a business contact, and cards may be handed over at any point during the meeting rather than following a strict ritual. Cards are commonly printed in English on one side and Arabic on the other, and presenting or receiving with the right hand (or both hands) is expected.
local_tip: Print your card with English on one side and Arabic on the other, and offer and receive it with your right hand or both hands.

also_check.note: Highly ceremonial: present and receive with both hands, bow slightly, and study the card before putting it away.
Use both hands and present with the text facing the recipient; never stuff a card straight into a pocket.
Cards are not strictly required, but if used one side should be in Arabic and offered with the right hand.
